text:
Chris (Eng): Hey @people-ops — my Jan 31 direct deposit is short by about $1,200. I updated my SSN in Workday mid-payrun (on Jan 25) and it looks like federal/state withholding was calculated against my old/mismatched SSN. Can someone advise next steps?
Samir (People Ops): Sorry to hear that, @Chris. Please don't post your full SSN here. Can you DM me the last 4 digits and attach a redacted paystub screenshot? Also drop the PAYRUN ID if you have it.
Chris (Eng): DMed you the last 4 (1234) and uploaded a redacted paystub to the thread (redacted). PAYRUN ID from the payroll confirmation email is PR-2026-01-31-42.
payroll-bot:
```
Payroll system: payrun PR-2026-01-31-42 | status: COMPLETED | submitted: 2026-01-30T22:10:05Z
Affected employee: chris@redwood.dev | update noted: ssn change 2026-01-25T16:03:00Z
```
Lina (Payroll): Thanks @Chris/@Samir. Quick notes: 1) We see the SSN update happened after payroll taxes calc for PR-2026-01-31-42, so withholdings used the old SSN values. 2) Usual remediation paths: a) off-cycle adjustment (one-off gross/net/top-up) to correct net pay; b) retro tax corrections and possibly a W-2c if federal/state withholding totals need amendment.
Lina (Payroll): To proceed we need: - copy of the redacted paystub (you posted, good) - confirmation you sent SSN change request (Workday request ID or screenshot) - consent to run an off-cycle payment (there's a small processing fee for some banks, we'll check).
Chris (Eng): Confirmed I submitted the Workday change and have the confirmation screenshot. I consent to an off-cycle adjustment. If possible request to prioritize — this shortfall hits rent timing. :pray: 
Samir (People Ops): Copying the payroll ticket: I'll open a high-priority case with request: "off-cycle top-up for PR-2026-01-31-42 due to SSN change processed mid-payrun" and include the Workday confirmation. Lina, do you need anything else for approvals?
Lina (Payroll): That's perfect. I'll run the audit today: verify totals, run tax re-calc, and if adjustment is purely net we can schedule off-cycle within 3 business days. If we must adjust withholding records, we may need to prepare a W-2c at year-end — we'll flag for tax. I'll update the ticket with timeline and expected gross adjustment amount.
Chris (Eng): Appreciate it, thank you both. Please ping me if you need any other docs.
Samir (People Ops): Follow-up: I filed ticket #PO-2026-337 with payroll and flagged as P1. Lina will update the ticket with estimated payment date. I will check back by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark: 
Lina (Payroll): Marking action items: 1) audit PR-2026-01-31-42 (in progress) 2) prepare off-cycle if eligible 3) confirm bank cutoff for same-week ACH 4) log W-2c potential. Will update in ticket thread.
Chris (Eng): Great — thanks, all.
